text: Do what you can with what you have right where you are

text: You will face many defeats in life but never let yourself be defeated

text: If you want to lift yourself up lift up someone else

text: The greatest wealth is to live content with very little in heart

text: Everything you have ever wanted is sitting on the other side of fear

text: To be yourself in a conformist world is the greatest triumph

text: Do not wait to strike till the iron is hot make it hot

text: We become what we think about most of the waking time

text: What we achieve inwardly will change outer reality in surprising ways

text: If you tell the truth you do not need to remember anything

text: It always seems impossible until it is finally achieved by someone

text: A room without books is like a body without a soul

text: He who has courage and faith will never perish in misery

text: Your time is limited so do not waste it living someone else life

text: It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see light

text: To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is greatest accomplishment
